title: Legal Manager - Education
description:
Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Legal Manager with a strong background in the education sector, particularly in school operations, school group management and education-related legal matters.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing legal and regulatory matters, contract management, investment transactions, legal due diligence for school acquisitions, and legal support for new school development projects.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Legal & Contract Management
  
  
- Draft, review, negotiate and vet commercial agreements, vendor contracts, service agreements, NDAs, MoUs and partnership agreements.
  
- Manage legal agreements relating to schools, educational institutions and external service providers.
  
- Identify contractual risks and provide appropriate legal recommendations.
  
  
2. Corporate Transactions & Fund-Raising
  
  
- Draft and negotiate investor term sheets.
  
- Review Share Subscription Agreements (SSA), Shareholders' Agreements (SHA) and related transaction documents.
  
- Support fund-raising transactions involving SEBI Category II AIFs.
  
- Coordinate with investors, external legal counsel, auditors and company secretaries.
  
- Monitor post-investment compliance and investor obligations.
  
  
3. Brownfield School Acquisition & Due Diligence
  
  
- Lead legal due diligence for existing schools proposed for acquisition or takeover.
  
- Review school ownership structures, trust/society/company documents and governance arrangements.
  
- Verify land titles, lease agreements, encumbrances and property documentation.
  
- Review school affiliation, recognition, NOCs and statutory approvals.
  
- Evaluate employee contracts and statutory liabilities.
  
- Coordinate legal due diligence reports and recommend appropriate transaction structures.
  
  
4. Greenfield School Projects
  
  
- Handle legal due diligence for new school establishment projects.
  
- Review land acquisition, title verification, leases and development agreements.
  
- Coordinate statutory approvals, school recognition, affiliation and regulatory requirements.
  
- Review construction, contractor and infrastructure-related agreements.
  
  
5. Regulatory Compliance
  
  
- Ensure compliance with applicable education laws and regulations, including CBSE, ICSE, State Board requirements, RTE and other relevant statutory provisions.
  
- Advise management on legal and regulatory matters affecting school operations.
  
  
Mandatory Candidate Requirements
  
  
- LLB degree is mandatory.
  
- 7–10 years of post-qualification legal experience.
  
- Prior experience working with a school group, school chain, K-12 education organisation or established education management company is mandatory.
  
- Strong experience in legal drafting, contract review and negotiation.
  
- Experience in school acquisitions, takeovers and legal due diligence.
  
- Hands-on exposure to investor term sheets and corporate transaction documentation.
  
- Experience in SEBI Category II AIF funding and related transaction documents.
  
- Strong understanding of corporate, commercial, real estate and education laws.
  
  
Key Competencies
  
  
- Corporate and commercial legal advisory.
  
- Contract drafting and negotiation.
  
- School acquisition and legal due diligence.
  
- Investment and fund-raising documentation.
  
- Education sector regulatory compliance.
  
- Stakeholder management and coordination with external legal counsel.
  
- Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Application Process
  
  
Interested candidates meeting the above criteria may share their updated CV at:
  
  
Email: info@transhr.in
  
  
Subject: Application – Legal Manager
  
  
Only candidates meeting the mandatory experience and qualification criteria will be considered.

title: Legal Intern
description:
**J**

﻿
**ob Description**

**Position - Legal Intern**

**Department - Legal**

**Duration - 3 Months**

**Stipend - 10,000/-**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Legal Intern to assist the Legal/Compliance team with day-to-day legal activities, including contract drafting and review, legal research, documentation, cheque-bounce and recovery matters, disputes, notices, compliance, and litigation coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Assist in drafting, reviewing, and organizing contracts, NDAs, MOUs, vendor/customer agreements, service agreements, employment documents, indemnities, settlements, and other legal documents.

\* Assist with cheque-bounce, payment-default, and recovery matters, including reviewing supporting documents, preparing notice drafts, maintaining records, and tracking deadlines.

\* Assist in drafting and reviewing legal notices, replies, demand letters, undertakings, declarations, affidavits, and other correspondence under supervision.

\* Conduct legal research on applicable laws, regulations, judgments, and government notifications and prepare research notes.

\* Support the team in commercial disputes, negotiations, settlements, and conflict-resolution matters.

\* Assist with litigation and advocate coordination, including maintaining case files, hearing dates, notices, orders, and litigation trackers.

\* Assist with legal and regulatory compliance documentation and deadline tracking.

\* Support HR/legal matters, including employment agreements, confidentiality documents, policies, notices, and employee-related documentation.

\* Review and organize lease, property, business, and commercial documentation as required.

\* Maintain organized records of contracts, notices, disputes, recovery matters, litigation, settlements, and compliance documents.

\* Coordinate with HR, Finance, Sales, Procurement, Operations, management, and external advocates for legal requirements.

\* Assist in identifying contractual and legal risks and escalate matters requiring senior legal review.

\* Handle confidential information and ensure all assigned work is completed accurately and within deadlines.

**Required Skills**

\* Basic knowledge of Corporate, Commercial, Contract, and applicable business laws.

\* Good legal research, drafting, documentation, and analytical skills.

\* Strong written and verbal communication.

\* Attention to detail and ability to manage deadlines.

\* Good understanding of legal and commercial documents.

\* Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace.

\* Ability to maintain confidentiality.

\* Willingness to learn and work under supervision.

**Qualifications**

\* Pursuing LL.B./B.L. or LL.M.

\* Prior legal internship experience is an advantage but not mandatory.

\* Interest in Corporate Law, Commercial Law, Contracts, Litigation, Recovery, or Compliance preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**

A law student who is proactive, detail-oriented, responsible, eager to learn, and interested in gaining practical experience across contracts, disputes, documentation, compliance, and business-related legal matters.

title: Ai Governance
description:
**Join our dynamic Team at DHL Global Forwarding! We are looking for**
**GSC Data Protection Role**
**Role Purpose**
Support the Global Data Protection & AI Governance office by coordinating initiatives, preparing metrics and presentations, tracking actions, and following up with global, regional, and country stakeholders. The role provides practical project support across data protection & AI Governance activities, including DPRs, PIAs, other assessments, monitoring activities, risk and findings follow-up, and investigation support when needed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Protection Support Responsibilities**

* Support Global Data Protection Office reporting activities, including collection, validation, and consolidation of data protection metrics.
* Assist regions and countries with DPRs by tracking completion, following up on missing inputs, and organizing evidence and documentation, reassessing DPRs where quality improvement is required.
* Support PIAs by coordinating information requests, maintaining assessment trackers, following up on open actions, reassessing PIAs where quality improvement is required.
* Track data protection risks, findings, mitigation actions, and overdue items, escalating delays or quality concerns as needed.
* Coordinate data protection-related activities with Regional Data Protection Officers, Local Data Protection Officers, regional teams, country teams, and other stakeholders depending on the task.
* Conduct research on applicable regional and local data protection laws.

**AI Governance Support Responsibilities**

* Assist in the review and assessment of AI use cases to ensure compliance with applicable laws,

regulations, and internal governance requirements.
  
  
  

* Help identify, assess, and document legal, compliance, privacy, ethical, and operational risks associated with AI systems.
* Contribute to the implementation of requirements arising from the EU AI Act, GDPR, and other relevant digital regulations.
* Assist in maintaining AI governance documentation, inventories, records, templates, and guidance materials.
* Monitor developments in AI-related legislation, standards, and regulatory guidance, including the EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2, Data Act, and other relevant frameworks.
* Contribute to internal communications, FAQs, guidance documents, presentations, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Prepare management reports, dashboards, presentations, and other materials related to AI governance activities.
* Identify recurring gaps, delays, documentation issues, and opportunities to simplify or standardize processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in law, Data Protection, Project Management, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in GDPR/EU AI Act & other data protection laws like CCPA/PIPL/POPIA etc, legal, data protection audit, risk management, project coordination.
* Good understanding of data protection principles & AI governance, with willingness to further develop knowledge of data protection governance, risk assessments, and privacy-related processes.
* Experience preparing metrics, presentations, trackers, reports, or management updates.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, especially PowerPoint and Excel; experience with SharePoint, Teams or similar platforms is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work with structured data, follow up on action items, and maintain accurate documentation.
* High attention to detail and ability to handle confidential or sensitive information appropriately.
* CIPP/E, AIGP certified or any other recognized relevant privacy or AI certification.
* Experience with OneTrust would be recommended.

**Core Competencies**

* Organized, structured, and process-oriented.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Project Management
* Ability to work with structured processes, templates and deadlines
* Strong follow-up discipline and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Clear and professional communicator.
* Detail-oriented, accurate, and reliable in documentation and reporting.
* Collaborative and service-minded, with the ability to work effectively with global, regional, and country stakeholders.
* Proactive in identifying gaps, delays, and improvement opportunities.
* Comfortable working in a global, cross-functional environment.

title: Assistant Manager - Direct & Indirect Tax
description:
*Business Introduction*
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Position Chartered Accountant – Direct Tax & Indirect Tax
  
  
**Experience**
2–3+ years of relevant post-qualification experience
  
  
***Qualification***

* Chartered Accountant (CA) – Qualified with Strong academic and professional understanding of Direct and Indirect Taxation.
* Prior experience in a tax consultancy, CA firm, corporate tax department, or similar environment will be preferred

**Job Overview**
We are looking for a Chartered Accountant with 2–3+ years of relevant experience in Direct Tax and Indirect Tax. The candidate will be responsible for managing tax compliances, tax assessments, litigation, advisory and related tax matters.
  
  
The role will have a strong focus on Indirect Taxation, particularly GST, while also handling Direct Tax matters. The candidate should have hands-on experience in tax compliance and litigation and possess the ability to independently handle routine tax matters.
  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* Indirect Tax :
* Review of Input & Output Register monthly for all the three company
* Review GST transactions and advise business teams on the taxability and GST implications of transactions.
* Handle GST-related notices, queries, assessments and departmental correspondence.
* Support IDT Manager in replying to GST notices and coordinate with tax authorities.
* Assist Tax Manager in GST audits, departmental audits, assessments and investigations.
* Assist in GST litigation and appeals at various levels.
* Monitor changes in GST laws, notifications, circulars, orders and case laws and assess their impact on the business.
* Review tax positions relating to ITC, RCM, place of supply, valuation, classification, exemptions and GST rates.
* Assist in GST refund applications and related follow-up.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consultants and external tax advisors on data compilation and relevant record for appeals.
* Support implementation of process improvements and automation in GST compliance and reporting.
* Direct Tax
* Assist in Data Compilation for Tax Assessment, Appeals and Court cases
* Preparation/review of Agreements/Contract for TDS & GST Applicability
* Review of Transfer Pricing Audit Report/Study Report
* Review of third Party benchmark studies
* Assist in preparation of responses to Income Tax notices/Tax default Notice.
* Assist in Income Tax assessments, appeals and litigation.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and authorities for Direct Tax matters.
* Monitor changes in Income Tax law, circulars, notifications and judicial developments.
* Tax Litigation & Assessments
* Assist Tax Head in handling tax notices, assessments and departmental proceedings.
* Assist in preparation of factual and legal submissions in consultation with senior management/tax advisors.
* Coordinate with consultants and legal professionals for tax litigation.
* Maintain records of notices, submissions, orders and appeal proceedings.
* Track litigation matters and ensure timely compliance with procedural requirements.
* Research relevant provisions, circulars, notifications and judicial precedents.
* Ensure Contingent Liability file and update regularly for the Internal Stake holder
* Maintain Tax related entry on timely manner for Refunds, Demand Paid any internal adjustment etc.
* Tax Advisory & Business Support
* Provide tax inputs to finance and business teams on day-to-day transactions.
* Review proposed business transactions from a Direct Tax and Indirect Tax perspective.
* Identify tax risks and suggest appropriate compliance measures.
* Assist in tax planning and implementation within the applicable legal framework.
* Prepare tax-related MIS, reports and management updates.
* Ensure timely escalation of significant tax risks and potential exposures.

***Key Skills & Competencies***
Mandatory
  
  

* Strong practical knowledge of GST and Indirect Taxation
* Good working knowledge of Income Tax and TDS
* Hands-on experience in tax compliance
* Practical exposure to tax notices, assessments and litigation
* Ability to independently handle routine tax matters
* Strong knowledge of GST law, rules, notifications, circulars and relevant case laws
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong communication and drafting skills
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, consultants and tax authorities
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and other relevant tax/compliance systems

**Preferred**

* Experience in handling complex GST issues such as RCM, place of supply, valuation, classification and input tax credit
* Exposure to tax advisory and transaction review
* Experience working in a corporate tax environment or reputed CA/tax firm

***Candidate Profile***
The ideal candidate should be:
  
  

* A qualified Chartered Accountant
* Having 2–3+ years of post-qualification experience
* Strong in Direct Tax & Indirect Tax/GST, with adequate knowledge of Direct Tax
* Experienced in tax compliances as well as litigation/assessments
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of tax matters
* Detail-oriented with strong analytical and drafting capabilities
* Proactive in identifying tax risks and keeping up with changes in tax laws
* Capable of working with business, finance, legal and external tax consultants

***Key Focus of the Role***

* Indirect Tax / GST 50%
* Direct Tax 50%

**Preferred Experience**
Candidates having practical experience in Direct Tax Compliance, Transfer Pricing Regulations, DT Litigations, TP Litigations, TDS Litigations, GST compliance, GST assessments, GST notices, GST litigation, ITC reconciliation and GST advisory will be preferred.
  
  
**Skills**
Business Acumen, Critical Thinking, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, Influencing Without Authority, Problem Solving, Tax Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Legal Intern
description:
**Eligibility**

* Law students currently in 2nd to 4th year (5-year law course) or equivalent

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
